== Biography ==
{{African-American Sticker}} 
Mary was born about 1841. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-2573|Joseph Glasgow]] and [[Gilbert-25488|Lucy Gilbert]]. 

In around 1878, she married Archie Warren (1850-1922). They had no known children.

She passed away in 1921, in Roanoke County, Virginia.<ref>'''Death''': "Virginia, Death Certificates, 1912-1987", FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:QVR7-NWZQ : Tue Oct 14 08:45:58 UTC 2025), Entry for Mary Warren and Joe Glasglow, 6 Jul 1921.</ref> She was buried at the Old City Cemetery in Lynchburg, Virginia.<ref>'''Burial''': Find a Grave, database and images (https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/121430292/mary-warren: accessed November 4, 2025), memorial page for Mary Warren (1831–Jul 1921), Find a Grave Memorial ID 121430292, citing Old City Cemetery, Lynchburg, City of Lynchburg, Virginia, USA; Maintained by III (contributor 47426837).</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2573]] is assessed at 96% (proved). The held accounts connect this child to Joseph Glasgow and Lucy Gilbert’s Roanoke family, citing the 1866 cohabitation register. Mary’s death index specifically associates her with Joe Glasglow, corroborating the cohabitation-register family.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect 1866 row37 including children, then compare the child’s marriage/death parent fields.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:QVR7-NWZQ Death: "Virginia, Death Certificates, 1912-1987", FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:QVR7-NWZQ : Tue Oct 14 08:45:58 UTC 2025), Entry for Mary Warren and Joe Glasglow, 6 Jul 1921.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
